Real product shots typically have clear logos or none; AI often generates pseudo-text. Additionally, there is noticeable blur/compression artifacts at the handle-blade junction and overall softness, flagged by both the Router and perceptual auditor. These artifacts lower the quality score significantly below a pristine reference image.
